hero.name: Jesús Lobato González
hero.subtitle: Software developer focused on Angular, PrimeNG, and Android.
hero.description: I build modern, clean, and maintainable interfaces. I enjoy working from a solid design base and well-structured code, taking care of both the visual experience and the technical clarity of the product.

about.title: About me
about.paragraph_1: Higher Technician in Multiplatform Application Development, focused on software development for web and Android applications. My main strength is building solutions with clean, maintainable, and easy-to-scale code.
about.paragraph_2: I recently gained experience building an ERP from scratch as part of a team during my internship, using Angular, GitFlow, Scrum, and solid engineering practices. I am especially interested in teamwork and continuous improvement through code reviews and well-structured design systems.
